issues.explanation: 目が回る is a fixed idiomatic expression meaning to feel dizzy; it should be kept together rather than split into ordinary compositional tokens.
issues.suggested_fix: Group as the idiom 「目が回り」, lemma 「目が回る」, reading 「めがまわり」, meaning “feel dizzy.”

issues.explanation: 胸が悪くなる is a fixed expression meaning to feel sick or nauseated, not simply “the chest becomes bad.”
issues.suggested_fix: Group as 「胸が悪くなった」, lemma 「胸が悪くなる」, reading 「むねがわるくなった」, meaning “felt sick/nauseated.”

issues.explanation: 目を覚ます is a fixed idiom meaning “wake up,” so it should be kept together.
issues.suggested_fix: Group as 「目を覚ます」, lemma 「目を覚ます」, reading 「めをさます」, meaning “wake up.”
